result.instructions: Tools for OnePageCRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are open in the sales pipeline, and what is each one worth?"; "Show the contacts at Acme Ltd and their latest notes."; "Add a note to Jan Novak's contact that the proposal was sent today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes OnePageCRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run onepagecrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run onepagecrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run onepagecrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. onepagecrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: onepagecrm_get_account
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Return the account's lead sources, deal stages, tags and the logged-in user's settings (date format, time zone). The request-signing key is left out. Good first call. OnePageCRM: GET /bootstrap.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List every user on the account with name, email, role and rights. OnePageCRM: GET /users.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_pipelines
tools.title: List deal pipelines
tools.description: List the account's deal pipelines with their ordered stages. Use the ids with onepagecrm_list_deals. OnePageCRM: GET /pipelines.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_statuses
tools.title: List contact statuses
tools.description: List the contact statuses in their configured order, with counts. A contact's status field holds the system id used by change_contact_status. OnePageCRM: GET /statuses.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts you can access, filtered by search text, owner, company, status, tag, e-mail, phone or star. OnePageCRM: GET /contacts.json.

search.description: Search text across contact names and fields.

owner_id.description: Only contacts owned by this user id.

company_id.description: Only contacts linked to this company id.

status_id.description: Only contacts with this status id (e.g. lead).

email.description: Only contacts with this e-mail address.

phone.description: Only contacts with this phone number.

tools.name: onepagecrm_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Return one contact with its phones, e-mails, addresses, tags, status and custom fields. OnePageCRM: GET /contacts/{contact_id}.json.

contact_id.description: Contact id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: onepagecrm_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create one contact. Give last_name or company_name (one is required). Nothing is e-mailed. OnePageCRM: POST /contacts.json.

company_name.description: Links to a company with this name, or creates it.

owner_id.description: Owner user id (default: the calling user).

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List the notes logged against contacts, optionally for one contact or company. OnePageCRM: GET /notes.json.

contact_id.description: Only notes on this contact id.

company_id.description: Only notes on this company id.

tools.name: onepagecrm_create_contact_note
tools.title: Add note to contact
tools.description: Log a note against one contact. Optionally link it to a deal. OnePageCRM: POST /contacts/{contact_id}/notes.json.

contact_id.description: Contact id (from a list or get tool).

linked_deal_id.description: Deal id to link the note to.

tools.name: onepagecrm_change_contact_status
tools.title: Change contact status
tools.description: Move one contact to another status (for example from lead to customer). OnePageCRM: PUT /contacts/{contact_id}/change_status/{status_id}.json.

contact_id.description: Contact id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies, filtered by search text, owner, status or tag. OnePageCRM: GET /companies.json.

search.description: Search text across company names and fields.

tools.name: onepagecrm_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Return one company with its fields and linked contacts. OnePageCRM: GET /companies/{company_id}.json.

company_id.description: Company id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals, filtered by search text, status, owner, contact, company or pipeline. OnePageCRM: GET /deals.json.

tools.name: onepagecrm_get_deal
tools.title: Get deal
tools.description: Return one deal with its value, stage, contact and custom fields. OnePageCRM: GET /deals/{deal_id}.json.

deal_id.description: Deal id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: onepagecrm_list_actions
tools.title: List actions
tools.description: List next actions (tasks), filtered by status (asap, date, date_time, waiting, queued, queued_with_date, done), contact, company or assignee. OnePageCRM: GET /actions.json.

status.description: Action status, e.g. date_time or done.

assignee_id.description: Only actions assigned to this user id.

tools.name: onepagecrm_mark_action_done
tools.title: Mark action done
tools.description: Mark one action (task) complete. OnePageCRM: PUT /actions/{action_id}/mark_as_done.json.

action_id.description: Action id (from a list or get tool).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with OnePageCRM
prompts.description: What you can do with OnePageCRM here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_open_deals_by_pipeline
prompts.title: Review open deals by pipeline
prompts.description: List the deal pipelines with their stages. List the deals, then read one deal for its value and stage.

prompts.name: look_up_a_company_and_its_notes
prompts.title: Look up a company and its notes
prompts.description: List the companies, then read one company with its linked contacts. List the notes logged against that company.

prompts.name: find_follow_up_tasks
prompts.title: Find follow-up tasks
prompts.description: List the next actions, filtered by status, contact, company or assignee. Read a contact for context.

prompts.name: log_a_call_and_move_a_lead_forward
prompts.title: Log a call and move a lead forward
prompts.description: Add a note to a contact, optionally linked to a deal. Then change the status of the contact, for example from lead to customer.

prompts.name: add_a_contact_and_close_a_task
prompts.title: Add a contact and close a task
prompts.description: Create a contact with a last name or a company name. Mark an action done when the task is finished.
